title: MIRROR: Aligning Semantic Relations from Language to Image via Gromov–Wasserstein
tldr_zh: 把 GW 逆问题做成 MLLM 训练正则，闭式解给出理想视觉几何，关系推理提升且通用 VQA 不降
tldr_en: Semi-inverse GW regularizer aligns visual geometry to language relational structure in MLLMs, improving relational reasoning without hurting general VQA
